title: Pay a list of people after approval
summary: Pay everyone on a list (suppliers, refunds, prizes, commissions) once, after one approval, from whichever payments account you connected, and keep a record.
description: Put the people to pay in a table with a batch name, then start the workflow with that batch. It checks each row has an amount and full bank details, shows the approver the total, the balance and any row it will not pay, and only after approval pays each person once, however often anything is retried. It waits for each bank payment to be confirmed, records how every payment went, and tells the owner. Works with Paystack, Moniepoint, iswallet, Flutterwave or Anchor.

params.name: list_table
params.title: List of people to pay
params.description: The table with the people to pay, each row with its batch, amount (naira) and bank details.

params.name: rail_connection
params.title: Pay from
params.description: The payments account the money comes out of: any you connected that can pay bank accounts.

params.name: funding_account
params.title: Wallet to pay from
params.description: Only for iswallet and Anchor, which hold several wallets: the one payments come out of. Leave it blank otherwise.

params.name: approver_role
params.title: Who approves
params.description: The role that approves before any money moves. Whoever set the workflow up cannot approve it themselves.

params.name: approval_hours
params.title: Hours to approve
params.description: If nobody approves within this many hours, nothing is paid and the owner is told.

outputs.name: approved
outputs.title: Approved
outputs.description: Whether the payments were approved. Nobody is paid otherwise.

outputs.name: paid
outputs.title: People paid
outputs.description: How many people were paid and the payment confirmed.

outputs.name: unconfirmed
outputs.title: Payments not confirmed
outputs.description: How many payments were sent but not confirmed by the bank yet.

outputs.name: not_paid
outputs.title: Not paid
outputs.description: Each person not paid, with why.

outputs.name: lines
outputs.title: Each payment
outputs.description: One row per person: batch, name, amount_naira, status (paid, failed or unconfirmed), payout_id and reason.

tables.name: {{list_table}}
tables.title: People to pay
tables.description: Each row is one payment; rows with the same batch are paid together.

tables.name: list_payments
tables.title: List payments
tables.description: One row per person per batch: how their payment went.

definition.name: Pay a list
definition.description: Pays every row of a batch once, after approval, through the connected payments account.

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: The batch to pay, as written in the list. It is also the reference each person sees on their statement.

steps.name: Check each row has an amount and bank details

output.people: =(has(steps.read_list.output.rows) ? steps.read_list.output.rows : []).filter(r, has(r.amount_naira) && r.amount_naira != null && double(r.amount_naira) >= 1.0 && has(r.bank_code) && r.bank_code != null && string(r.bank_code) != '' && has(r.account_number) && r.account_number != null && string(r.account_number) != '' && string(r.account_number).size() == 10 && has(r.account_name) && r.account_name != null && string(r.account_name) != '').map(r, {'id': has(r.id) ? string(r.id) : '', 'name': (has(r.name) && r.name != null && string(r.name) != '' ? string(r.name) : (has(r.account_name) && r.account_name != null ? string(r.account_name) : 'Row ' + (has(r.id) ? string(r.id) : ''))), 'kobo': int(math.round(double(r.amount_naira) * 100.0)), 'bank_code': string(r.bank_code), 'account_number': string(r.account_number), 'account_name': string(r.account_name)})
output.refused: =(has(steps.read_list.output.rows) ? steps.read_list.output.rows : []).filter(r, !(has(r.amount_naira) && r.amount_naira != null && double(r.amount_naira) >= 1.0 && has(r.bank_code) && r.bank_code != null && string(r.bank_code) != '' && has(r.account_number) && r.account_number != null && string(r.account_number) != '' && string(r.account_number).size() == 10 && has(r.account_name) && r.account_name != null && string(r.account_name) != '')).map(r, {'name': (has(r.name) && r.name != null && string(r.name) != '' ? string(r.name) : (has(r.account_name) && r.account_name != null ? string(r.account_name) : 'Row ' + (has(r.id) ? string(r.id) : ''))), 'reason': (!(has(r.amount_naira) && r.amount_naira != null && double(r.amount_naira) >= 1.0) ? 'no amount to pay' : !(has(r.account_number) && r.account_number != null && string(r.account_number).size() == 10) ? 'the account number is not 10 digits' : 'the bank details are incomplete')})

subject.warning: =steps.balance.output.available_kobo >= steps.totals.output.total_kobo ? '' : 'The balance is less than the total to pay'

steps.name: Wait for the bank to confirm

output.rows: =steps.pay_all.output.map(o, {'batch': trigger.body.batch, 'name': o.person.name, 'amount_naira': double(o.person.kobo) / 100.0, 'status': (has(o.pay_failed) ? 'failed' : o.pay.status == 'settled' ? 'paid' : o.pay.status == 'failed' ? 'failed' : has(o.settle) ? (o.settle.status == 'settled' ? 'paid' : o.settle.status) : 'unconfirmed'), 'payout_id': has(o.pay) && has(o.pay.payout_id) ? o.pay.payout_id : '', 'reason': (has(o.pay_failed) ? o.pay_failed.reason : has(o.pay.reason) ? o.pay.reason : has(o.settle) && has(o.settle.reason) ? o.settle.reason : has(o.settle_failed) ? 'the payment was not confirmed' : '')})

steps.name: Tell the owner how the payments went

input.title: ='Payments ' + trigger.body.batch
input.message: ='Payments ' + trigger.body.batch + ': ' + string(steps.summary.output.paid) + ' paid (NGN ' + string(steps.summary.output.paid_naira) + '), ' + string(steps.summary.output.failed) + ' failed, ' + string(steps.summary.output.unconfirmed) + ' not confirmed yet.' + (size(steps.summary.output.not_paid) > 0 ? ' Not paid: ' + steps.summary.output.not_paid.join(', ') + '.' : '')

steps.name: Tell the owner nothing was paid

input.title: ='Payments ' + trigger.body.batch + ' not made'
input.message: ='Payments ' + trigger.body.batch + ' were ' + (has(steps.approve.output.reason) && steps.approve.output.reason == 'timeout' ? 'not approved in time' : 'rejected') + ', so nobody was paid.'
